stamp: {"keys":[{"id":"k","problem":"A company's page lists its provident and study funds but not its index-tracking funds or money-market funds.","where":"the product choices at the top of the company page","kind":"general"}],"liked":[]}

raised: Doesn't know whether their existing Harel savings are in this product at all (page just opened on קופת גמל להשקעה)
"רשות שוק ההון" in the gray text means nothing to them
The "123 ממקור / מחושב / הזנתה" line is confusing and seems pointless
Product buttons are confusing: can't tell which one is 'my savings'; "תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים" unclear
Fine print about the legal cap and trading fees is only half understood; extra costs they can't see
Donut charts and colored dots add nothing; yellow "מט"ח" meaning has to be guessed
"קופה" column and its blue numbers mean nothing
"ההפקדה 0%" lines are useless since everything is 0%
"פחות מ־3 שנים" in most rows means no return figure for most tracks
Unclear whether the fee is on savings (ההיסכון) or on each deposit (ההפקדה)
"PF-10" not understood
"לפני מס" unclear: how much tax and when
Doesn't understand why S&P 500 track shows 13.7% while מניות shows 24%
Tags under track names (e.g. עוקב מדדי אג"ח, אג"ח סחיר) not understood
Page doesn't explain what קופת גמל להשקעה is (withdrawal, minimum)
No shekel-based example of what an investment would be worth after fees
No way to tell if Harel is cheap or expensive compared to other companies
No information on how to actually sign up
Would drop the "מה כתוב במסמכים של הראל" list
Would drop the collapsed "קרנות מחקות / מרכזית לפיצויים / קרנות סל" sections

problems.why: The reader mentions the collapsed קרנות מחקות/קרנות סל sections only to skip them or drop them, and never says index-tracking or money-market funds are missing from the product choices at the top.
